summary: Pinned Transit Facts A (full-stack, additive + fail-open). A user pins a known public-transit duration for a recurring adjacent location pair; that user-authored fact feeds the same cycle-76 day-feasibility gap math as a fresh provider fact but is provenance-labeled (source=pinned_user) and never masquerades as live provider data. New SQLite pinned_transit_facts (additive migration 0012) keyed by the DIRECTIONAL uniqueIndex (origin_normalized, dest_normalized, mode=public_transit); CHECKs mode∈public_transit / source∈pinned_user / active∈0,1 / duration_minutes >0 and <=600; coords REAL NOT NULL, SERVER-derived from resolved geocode_cache (never browser-supplied). Shared: transitFacts.ts (PinnedTransitFact .strict; UpsertPinnedTransitRequest .strict {fromEventId,toEventId,durationMinutes 1..600,note?≤200} — NO coordinate fields, .strict rejects them; response + error codes); feasibility.ts TransitionTravelSchema += optional source enum(provider|pinned_user), back-compat. Repo pinned-transit-facts.ts (findPinnedByPair/listActivePinned/idempotent upsertPinned — re-pin refreshes last_confirmed_at). Service upsertPinnedTransitFact resolves both event ids → authored locations → EXISTING resolved geocode rows (findGeocodeByNormalizedSet, NO geocode/provider call), derives the directional pair identity + coords server-side, upserts one fact; typed errors not_found/location_missing/location_unresolved leave the DB untouched. Route PUT /api/transit-facts/pair (registered when db): 400 validation (coord fields rejected), 404, 409 LOCATION_MISSING, 409 LOCATION_UNRESOLVED (no write each), 200 + re-pin no duplicate. Precedence: buildDayTravelFacts gains pinnedByPair (buildPinnedPairMap fail-open try/catch→empty map); per pair AFTER missing_geocode/same_location but BEFORE resolvePair, a pinned fact short-circuits to {status:fresh, source:pinned_user, durationMinutes, provider:null, reasonCodes:[travel_pinned_transit]} with NO provider/cache call. Pure feasibility travelGapReason: fresh+source pinned_user → gap_travel_pinned_included (same duration*travelMargin); sequenceEnergy reads only costLevel so no double-count; absent pinned fact = byte-identical cycle-76 behavior. All three routes (feasibility/day, today, preview) load pinned facts; preview reads but writes none. Frontend Today.tsx: TransitionTravelLine shows '고정 이동 약 N분' (data-source pinned_user) distinct from a provider estimate; TransitionCostsSection gains an optional pin controller (data-in/callbacks-out, page owns state) rendering a per-row '고정 이동시간' add/update form (duration + optional note) that PUTs {fromEventId,toEventId,durationMinutes,note?} (no coords) and on success refreshes Today; a scoped error (server {ok:false} or invalid 1..600 duration) shows role=alert without breaking Today; the cycle-77 Naver '길찾기' link remains. styles.css .feas-pin*/.feas-travel--pinned (44px). No Naver API/scrape/credential, schedule mutation, or LLM. Tests: shared +7 (pinned schemas + travel source), repo+service integration +11, route integration +3, travel precedence +1, feasibility-route pinned/preview +2, frontend +4; 195 existing Today tests pass.
